not_eligible_because: every board is the vendored Triangle engine's; which bag-1 spin and which bag-2 and later shape was built has no second implementation. The Perfect Clear COUNT is anchored by perfect_clear_timing, the shape is not.
caveat: bag-1 opportunities count rounds that reached 6 locks clean (inside the verified prefix, no clear, no garbage before it); the spin step counts those whose 7th lock is inside the verified prefix with no garbage before it, and asserts a node only when that lock is a T on exactly one drawn U slot. bag-2 and snapshot opportunities allow garbage: complete garbage rows are stripped from the bottom of the board first (garbage_rows_stripped), so they count rounds inside the verified prefix with no line cleared by the player before the sample but the bag-1 TSS. There is no harddrop field for this opener, so no flag. bag2_near is measured against the board before the first TSD, never a match.

rules.bag1_spin: a full T-spin clearing 1 line on exactly one child board's U cells, in the bag-1 match's handedness
rules.bag2_garbage: strip complete garbage rows from the bottom
rules.bag2_route_clear: the bag-1 TSS is the route's own clear
rules.condition_handedness: a mirrored round's bag-2 order is read with J<->L and S<->Z swapped
rules.bag2_near: a bag-1 round with no bag-2 match: the board before its first TSD, by occupancy, against every bag-2 board: a strict subset (the TSD before the board was complete), that board plus exactly four cells, that board with one piece's four cells moved elsewhere, or else the nearest bag-2 board(s) when they differ by at most 8 cells (two pieces' worth): measured, never a match
